title: Versioned parallel tool result aggregation
source_note: Authored development fixture with an explicitly bounded protocol; not an external benchmark or production incident. Python standard-library semantics only.

defect_notes.incident: Allows older retries to replace newer results; mutates live state during an ingest that can later fail, leaking partial updates.
defect_notes.normal: Reference implementation satisfying the documented lifecycle, data, failure and isolation contract.
defect_notes.local: Uses absolute sample values in the score calculation; merge/version/atomicity/isolation mechanisms are unchanged.

validation_scope: Single-threaded in-memory aggregator; no process crash persistence or concurrent-thread guarantee is claimed.
Version, isolation and atomicity checks use finite representative sequences; all possible operation histories are not enumerated.
Schema examples include booleans, floats and unhashable IDs but are not exhaustive fuzzing.
